# grove doctor --fix: keep locked stale worktree entries
setup_workspace

mkdir ../.bare/worktrees/locked-orphan
cp $WORK/orphan-gitdir ../.bare/worktrees/locked-orphan/gitdir
exec touch ../.bare/worktrees/locked-orphan/locked

exec grove doctor --fix
stdout 'Git Issues \(1 warning\)'
stdout '⚠ Stale worktree entry in locked-orphan'
exists ../.bare/worktrees/locked-orphan
exists ../.bare/worktrees/locked-orphan/locked

-- orphan-gitdir --
/nonexistent/path/.git
